caption: The drawing features a single object, a duck decoy, positioned in profile facing to the left. The decoy has a distinctly carved head and body with visible wood grain texture throughout, indicating it is made of wood. The coloring of the decoy is primarily in shades of brown and gray, with the upper part of the body and head in darker brown tones, and the lower body in a lighter, almost beige color. The bill is dark brown and broad, blending with the coloration of the head. The eye of the decoy is round and appears to be painted or inlaid in a reddish color. There is a soft, subtle shading and textural detail that gives the decoy a slightly weathered appearance. The background is a uniform, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery present, providing a neutral setting that emphasizes the shape and form of the duck decoy.
title: Decoy: Blue Winged Teal
